name: Seven Deadly Dates
source:
You've studied latin for a few months and you accidentally read a passage from your textbook which lands you in a demon speed dating bar. Unsure of how to get home, you decide to ride it out and see how things go. Maybe you'll even find a date! Or maybe you'll find death? Who knows...

[From [url=https://sevendeadlydates.uwu.ai/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你已经学习了几个月的拉丁语，你不小心读到了课本上的一段话，这让你进入了一个恶魔般的快速约会酒吧。由于不确定如何回家，你决定度过难关，看看情况如何。也许你甚至会找到约会对象！或者也许你会发现死亡？谁知道…

[来自[url=https://sevendeadlydates.uwu.ai/]官网[/url]]
